# Measured MIT KEMAR fixture

Bill Gardner and Keith Martin measured these HRTFs at the MIT Media Laboratory
in 1994. Copyright 1994 MIT Media Laboratory. The authors permit unrestricted
use when they are cited; see the [official author page](https://sound.media.mit.edu/resources/KEMAR.html).

The unmodified normal-pinna SOFA file comes from the
[official SOFA repository](https://sofacoustics.org/data/database/mit/).
Its SHA-256 and download URL are in `manifest.json`. No fixture-level resampling,
normalization, cropping or denoising has been applied.

The authors document 710 measured positions from -40 degrees to +90 degrees
elevation, recorded at 44.1 kHz with a loudspeaker 1.4 m from the mannequin.
This is a measured mannequin dataset. It does not supply below-coverage directions,
individual human calibration, listener ratings or hardware motion latency.
